description.value: Glassblowing is one of the few crafts that cannot be paused. That particular pressure shaped how you think, and a tendency to act decisively when others are still deliberating has followed you out of the workshop.

system.startingEquipment:
Common clothes
work gloves
work boots
system.features: Patron Contacts: Fine glasswork serves scholars, alchemists, and wealthy collectors who have few reliable suppliers. You have cultivated relationships with these patrons over years of commissioned work. In most cities you can find a scholar, alchemist, or collector who knows your name or your reputation and will offer access to their resources, libraries, or professional networks in exchange for your expertise.
